Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted a misleading search-result snippet (Discogs showing “Country: US”) and inferred there were multiple distinct bands named “Dark At Dawn,” instead of opening and verifying authoritative sources (Metal Archives, Wikipedia, official site) that consistently show Dark at Dawn is a German band. This unverified assumption triggered unnecessary disambiguation loops and prevented the straightforward conclusion that The Catheters (USA) and Dark at Dawn (Germany) are not from the same country.
